# =========================================================
# NaturaFruct — Apache configuration (generated by build.mjs)
# =========================================================
Options -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html
AddDefaultCharset utf-8
AddType image/svg+xml .svg
AddType application/manifest+json .webmanifest
AddType font/woff2 .woff2

ErrorDocument 404 /404.html
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/en/#">
  ErrorDocument 404 /en/404.html
</If>

# Private files
<FilesMatch "^(contact-config\.php|contact-labels\.json)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On

  # --- Canonical host: https://www.naturafruct.ro (skipped on localhost) ---
  # If you prefer the bare domain, change this block AND siteUrl in src/config.mjs.
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off [OR]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^www\. [NC]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(?:www\.)?(.+)$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ https://www.%1%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]

  # --- 301 redirects from the old Joomla site (keeps SEO value) ---
  RewriteRule ^ro/?$ / [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/despre-noi/?$ /despre-noi/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/fabrica-si-utilaje/?$ /despre-noi/#fabrica [R=301,NE,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/produse/?$ /produse/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/magazine/?$ /contact/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/galerie-foto(/.*)?$ /despre-noi/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/diverse/bag-in-box/?$ /despre-noi/#ambalare [R=301,NE,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/diverse(/.*)?$ /despre-noi/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^ro/contact/?$ /contact/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^en/factory-and-equipment/?$ /en/about-us/#fabrica [R=301,NE,L]
  RewriteRule ^en/partner-stores/?$ /en/contact/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^en/galerie-foto-2(/.*)?$ /en/about-us/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^en/various/bag-in-box/?$ /en/about-us/#ambalare [R=301,NE,L]
  RewriteRule ^en/various(/.*)?$ /en/about-us/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)(option=com_|format=feed) [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ /? [R=301,L]
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
  Header always set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()"
  Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000" env=HTTPS
  Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' {{SCRIPT_HASH}}{{TURNSTILE}}; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://tile.openstreetmap.org; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'{{TURNSTILE}}; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'"
  <FilesMatch "\.(html)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "no-cache"
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On
  ExpiresDefault "access plus 1 hour"
  ExpiresByType text/html "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType text/css "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType text/javascript "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/jpeg "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/png "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/svg+xml "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType font/woff2 "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/pdf "access plus 1 month"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css text/plain text/xml application/xml application/javascript text/javascript application/json application/manifest+json image/svg+xml
</IfModule>
